# TG WS Proxy Android v1.2.4.1-rc4 — Connection Stability

RC4 is based on RC3 and focuses on three identified implementation issues:

- **Consistent direct transport.** Newly opened direct Telegram WebSocket connections and retry connections now use the same TLS mode (port 443) as pool connections. The existing CF transport configuration is unchanged.
- **Accurate WebSocket close diagnostics.** Close frames now report a distinct remote-close error with the status code and the length of the raw reason field. Socket EOF, read errors, timeout and local cancellation remain distinguishable. Message payloads and the close reason text are not logged.
- **Connection backpressure.** Fresh direct WebSocket attempts share a concurrency limit of four connections; additional attempts queue for up to one second and report a dedicated busy event. CF connections are excluded from this limit.

Android version: **1.2.4.1-rc4**, versionCode **139**. Includes unit tests for close/error classification.

**Scope:** No changes to CF routes, media fallback, credentials or certificate verification. Cellular direct-connect timeouts may remain if the route itself is unavailable. Test on Wi-Fi and cellular before treating the build as stable.
